name: Case Closure Update
response_html:
Dear {{ doc.employee_name }},


This is to inform you that the {% if doc.case_id and doc.case_id.startswith("UA") %}unauthorized absence case{% else %}disciplinary case{% endif %} initiated against you has been reviewed by the concerned authority. Based on the closure remarks and the final review, the case has been closed with the appropriate action: {{ doc.remarks }} .


Closure Details:

Case ID: {{ doc.case_id }}
Case Type: {{ doc.case_type or ("Unauthorized Absence" if doc.case_id and doc.case_id.startswith("UA") else "N/A") }}
Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}
Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}


You may contact the HR Department for further clarification if required.


Regards,
HR Department
subject: Case Closure Update for {{ doc.employee_name }} - Case ID: {{ doc.case_id }}
